summary: The blocked Phase 2 UI package received an additional integration preflight. The session control is functional by default, the design contract matches the shipped dark tokens, developer acceptance checks are documented, and a clean review archive is ready.
verification: The expanded package verifier passed 45 assertions across 14 required files.
The default application-shell session control now calls Supabase sign out, redirects to login, and exposes pending and recoverable error states.
The application-shell override preserves compatibility with existing application-specific session cleanup.
Primary text, muted text, primary button, and cyan accent contrast checks meet the documented minimum.
All production and preview image elements declare intrinsic dimensions.
Login, dashboard, and responsive Chrome renders were regenerated and visually inspected after the preflight changes.
The review archive contains only the intended source, assets, documents, verifier, and renders.
No repository, authentication environment, deployment, or external communication was changed.
assumptions: The private application uses the Supabase client and route structure described in the development handoff.
risks: A real repository build and live authentication test remain necessary because the exact package versions, middleware, and application cleanup are unavailable locally.
The package must remain on a review branch until the developer confirms the data adapters and preview environment.
